source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Πατέρνος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and it heads him «(500 - 565)». Its three sentences are the whole of the notice; it prints no couplet and no hymn. The day's line is bare, «Άγιος Πατέρνος», and the page is what identifies him as the bishop of Vannes in Brittany. The corpus holds nobody of this name, and no folder mentions Vannes.
